literal_meaning: ভাসমান বা ভেসে যাওয়া বস্তু (যেমন নৌকা বা পাত্র)
figurative_meaning_en: To drift away or become ruined and dispersed
example_sentences_in_bangla: বন্যার কারণে সব ফসল গুবলেট হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to the flood, all the crops have floated away.
The plan has all gone to pot.
history: Likely originates from frequent floods in Bengal, where belongings float away in rivers.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of items drifting in water, common in riverine Bengali culture.
